resolvedFindings.title: Required frozen inputs are not required by the hash loop
resolvedFindings.finding: lock.files is iterated but its key set is not checked. An omitted questions.json or gold.json entry is never hashed before the file is read at lines41-42. Empty or partial modelFiles is also accepted. This allows successful evaluation of bytes outside the supposed frozen input manifest without an input-hash failure.
resolvedFindings.requestedChange: Require the exact expected catalog/review/questions/gold entries and the declared complete model-file manifest before reading any protected input. Validate digest syntax and reject missing/extra input keys. Bind the model inventory to the frozen model manifest or verify full expected file coverage.

resolvedFindings.title: Product module is imported before its code hash is checked
resolvedFindings.finding: The import executes module and package initialization before sha('/app/src/api/multilingual_catalog.py') is compared to catalogCodeSha256. A mismatched mounted module can already perform side effects before aborting, violating fail-closed code provenance.
resolvedFindings.requestedChange: Verify the exact code bytes before import. Ensure package __init__ files are frozen or avoid importing unverified package initialization with a verified direct-file load. Verify the imported module resolves to the expected verified file.

resolvedFindings.title: Safety and acceptance preconditions disappear under Python optimization
resolvedFindings.finding: Every hash, executionAllowed, count and vector-integrity guard uses assert. Python -O or PYTHONOPTIMIZE removes these checks entirely, including the test for authorized execution and fixed input hashes.
resolvedFindings.requestedChange: Use explicit checks that raise a sanitized exception for critical gates, or at minimum reject optimized execution with an explicit if sys.flags.optimize check before main; explicit checks are preferred. Freeze the launcher and environment as separate evidence.
